description: This Java class 'GenericValue' handles persistence and relational operations for generic entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for creating, storing, removing, refreshing, and retrieving related entity data, including multi-relation support and dummy primary key generation.

classes.name: GenericValue
classes.description: A class representing a generic entity value object with persistence and relation management capabilities within OFBiz.

classes.name: NullGenericValue
classes.description: A singleton subclass representing a null or placeholder entity value.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory methods to instantiate GenericValue objects from various inputs such as ModelEntity, Map, or other GenericValue instances.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Persists the current GenericValue instance to the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the current GenericValue instance from the database.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current GenericValue instance from the database.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes the current GenericValue instance from cache.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related entities based on relation name, with options for filtering, ordering, and caching.

methods.name: getRelatedOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single related entity based on relation name, with optional caching.

methods.name: removeRelated
methods.description: Removes related entities based on relation name.

methods.name: getRelatedDummyPK
methods.description: Generates a dummy primary key for related entities, optionally filtered by fields.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name; overridden in NullGenericValue to return a placeholder.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow clone of the GenericValue instance.

methods.name: getStackTraceAsString
methods.description: Returns the current thread's stack trace as a string.
